name: Hashed-point searching
definition: A technique that accelerates ray-tracing-based point cloud rendering by transforming the 3D search space into a 2D image plane for hash table lookup, preserving all points within each pixel rather than just the nearest.
summary: Hashed-point searching accelerates ray-tracing by projecting 3D points into a 2D hash table, distinguishing itself through adaptive radius search ranges based on point distance rather than fixed radii.
